_doc: RO-9's curated exceptions (docs/governance/harbor-ro9-astral-toolchain.md § Population, curated exceptions): every non-Astral tool gzkit keeps, with the reason Astral ships no replacement, and every registered restatement of a fact, with the home it must agree with. Read by `gz validate --astral-discipline`. Re-read at each new uv, Ruff, ty or Python release (operator ruling 2026-10-19: "keep all astral tools up to date").

tools.name: pydantic
tools.reason: AGENTS.md § STDLIB-FIRST names Pydantic the one ratified departure, for validation; Astral ships no validation library.

tools.name: networkx
tools.reason: The ontology's graph substrate (ADR-0.32.0); `ruff analyze graph` reads Python import edges only and is no graph library.

tools.name: tree-sitter
tools.reason: The ontology's polyglot source anchors (ADR-0.32.0); Astral ships no parser library.

tools.name: lizard
tools.reason: Cyclomatic scores and module means for the C/C/C gate (GHI #1183's selection, operator 2026-10-09); Ruff C901 is per-function pass/fail with no metrics.

tools.name: cohesion
tools.reason: LCOM4 class cohesion for the complexity thresholds (ADR-0.0.27); Astral ships no cohesion metric.

tools.name: behave
tools.reason: The Gate 4 BDD runner (AGENTS.md § Gate Covenant); Astral ships no test runner.

tools.name: unittest-parallel
tools.reason: Runs the unittest-only suite in parallel (GHI #856); Astral ships no test runner.

tools.name: coverage
tools.reason: Measures the coverage floor (.gzkit/rules/tests.md § Coverage Floor); Astral ships no coverage tool.

tools.name: mkdocs
tools.reason: Builds the documentation site (Gate 3); Astral ships no documentation tool.

tools.name: mkdocs-material
tools.reason: The documentation site's theme, loaded by mkdocs.yml.

tools.name: pyinstaller
tools.reason: Builds the release binaries (release.yml); Astral ships no freezer.

tools.name: pre-commit
tools.reason: The hook framework; Astral ships hooks for it (ruff-pre-commit, uv-pre-commit), not a runner.

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.reason: Scans commits for secrets; Ruff S105 to S107 catch hard-coded passwords only.

restatements.reason: PyPI trove metadata, read by no Astral tool; its lowest Python classifier must equal the floor.
Read the Docs' build image requires an interpreter key even though the docs build through uv (RO-9 tranche 2); it must match the pin.

records.reason: Dated history of canonical step argv that already ran; each row keeps older ARB receipts valid and the table forbids editing a row, so it records an invocation and makes none.
A tuple of ARB receipt step names (ruff, typecheck, unittest), read as data to find receipts; it runs nothing.
